title: Understanding Orthogonality
text: In the context of linear regression, the residuals $$(Y-\hat{Y})$$ are orthogonal to the fitted values (\hat{Y}). This means that the dot product of the residuals and the fitted values is zero.

title: Geometric Interpretation
text: Think of the residuals as the component of Y that is not explained by the model. The orthogonality implies that this component is perpendicular to the plane formed by the fitted values.

title: Dot Product Calculation
text: Calculate the dot product of $$(Y-\hat{Y})$$ and \hat{Y}. What should this value be if they are orthogonal?

title: Residuals and Fitted Values
text: The residuals are the differences between the observed values and the predicted values. In OLS, these residuals are orthogonal to the space spanned by the columns of the design matrix.
